how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website www.jashpur.nic.in.
Fill out the prescribed application form completely with correct details.
Affix a self-attested photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Enclose self-attested copies of all required educational qualifications, mark sheets, and experience certificates.

Ensure that experience certificates explicitly state the full name of the issuing institute, postal address, date, designation and signature of issuing officer along with email verification details, and attach at least 06 months of bank statements or passbook showing salary/honorarium credits for non-governmental experience.
Place the application in a closed envelope and superscribe the name of the post applied for on top of the envelope.
Send the application via registered post or speed post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Jashpur, District-Jashpur (Chhattisgarh), PIN-496331.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 27 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time or through unregistered modes (such as direct or email) will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post. The applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh, supported by a valid domicile certificate. Contract appointment is initially for one year, subject to satisfactory annual performance evaluation and departmental requirements. Candidates employed in government or semi-government institutions must route their applications through proper channel along with an NOC. For experience in non-governmental organizations, candidates must provide a bank statement or bank passbook showing salary credits for at least 06 months. If the number of received applications is high, a ratio of 1 times to 10 applicants will be called based on merit ranking for the written/skill test. Any legal disputes are subject to final orders of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP (C) No. 19688/2022.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Jashpur Regional Coordinator Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 35 years for general category candidates, calculated as on 01 January 2025. Under no circumstances shall the maximum age exceed 45 years.

rows.relaxation: Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per government instructions issued from time to time for Chhattisgarh domicile residents and various categories.

As per Chhattisgarh General Administration Department letter dated 16.09.2026, regular government servants working in government services under the state, employees of boards/corporations/mandis, contractual workers, and former soldiers will have their upper age limit relaxed from 38 years to 48 years.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Jashpur Regional Coordinator Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list compiled from academic marks and experience scores, followed by a Written/Skill Test. Marks are distributed as follows: 35 marks for graduation percentage weightage, 20 marks for 12th standard percentage weightage, 20 marks for 10th standard percentage weightage, 10 marks for experience beyond minimum required (2 marks per completed full year of experience up to a maximum of 10 marks), 5 marks for experience of working in Chhattisgarh State Rural Livelihoods Mission (1 mark per completed full year up to a maximum of 5 marks), and 10 marks for the written/skill test, making a total of 100 marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zila Panchayat Jashpur Regional Coordinator
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website www.jashpur.nic.in . Fill out the prescribed application form completely with correct details. Affix a self-attested photograph on the designated space of the application form. Enclose self-attested copies of all required educational qualifications, mark sheets, and experience certificates. Ensure that experience certificates explicitly state the full name of the issuing institute, postal address, date, designation and signature of issuing officer along with email verification details, and attach at least 06 months of bank statements or passbook showing salary/honorarium credits for non-governmental experience. Send the application via registered post or speed post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Jashpur, District-Jashpur (Chhattisgarh), PIN-496331. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 27 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
